card.name: End of drug name before adverse effect
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug or drug-class name (e.g. antipsychotic, tetracycline, anthracycline, doxorubicin, phenytoin), right before a word like induced, associated or a toxicity term.

modes.label: Drug-class ending
modes.description: Final piece of a class name, followed by -induced or associated with a condition.
modes.example: risk for developing tetracy<<cline>> associated IH

modes.label: Drug-name ending
modes.description: Final piece of a single drug name, followed by a toxicity term.

modes.label: Cause phrase
modes.description: A cause word such as chemotherapy right before -induced.
modes.example: patients with<< chemotherapy>>-induced nausea and vomiting

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with -related, -induced or -associated, naming a drug-caused condition.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a drug name when the text is about to say a condition is caused by that drug.
